nodes.label: Stability Phase Evidence
nodes.rationale: Scoped to `fix: stability and minor workflow bugs`. Deliberately excludes Study workspace, online provider, VAD/detector optimization, packaging, release, tag, or publishing work.

nodes.label: Native Selection Reproduction
nodes.rationale: Real PySide6 MainWindow driven against an isolated temporary job. Demonstrates the selection-driven preview bug: before fix, current row 25, selected rows 0 and 25, yet preview showed `00:00:00.000 · frame 0` because the first selected row drove the preview; after fix, preview shows `00:04:10.000 · frame 6250`. Widget grabs and state JSONs preserve exact observed state.

nodes.label: Focused Validation
nodes.rationale: Ran focused pytest across ui, ollama/repair, scheduler/engines, packaging/safety, and stability-phase test modules: 55 passed in 95.10s. Full output and machine-readable signature details in focused_pytest_output.txt.

nodes.label: Close Latency Measurements
nodes.rationale: Measured close latency with an active worker that ignores cancellation for 1.2 seconds: worker detach 0.000038s, Context Repair dialog close 0.012972s, main application window close 0.004905s. Demonstrates responsive shutdown despite a non-cooperative worker.

nodes.label: Process Tree Tests
nodes.rationale: Process-tree tests launched real Python parent/child trees through QProcess and through both FFmpegWrapper and WhisperWrapper. Every owned root and child exited; taskkill returned 0. A separately launched unrelated control process remained alive until explicit cleanup, proving owned-process scoping.

nodes.label: Re-export Signature Preservation
nodes.rationale: Re-export compared SHA-256, byte size, and nanosecond modification time for 13 protected artifacts (audio WAV, candidates.json, eight candidate PNGs, raw JSON/SRT/TXT transcripts). Every before/after tuple matched, proving re-export does not mutate protected artifacts.

nodes.label: Full Regression Suite
nodes.rationale: Unit-strategy run of full regression: 121 passed in 150.53s. See full_pytest_output.txt.

nodes.label: Focused Pytest Session
nodes.rationale: win32 / Python 3.12.3 / pytest-9.1.1 / pluggy-1.6.0 / PySide6 6.11.1 with qt-4.5.0 plugin. Collected 55 items, 55 passed in 95.10s. Emits machine-readable key=value blocks for close latency, process-tree cleanup reports, and re-export signatures.

nodes.label: taskkill-pid-tree Strategy
nodes.rationale: Process-tree cleanup strategy named `taskkill-pid-tree`; taskkill_returncode 0 for app-close, process-tree, ffmpeg_cleanup and whisper_cleanup tests. Emitted with child_pid, root_pid and finished flags.

nodes.label: Re-export Signature Records
nodes.rationale: Re-export evidence for protected artifacts (audio lecture-16khz-mono.wav, candidates.json) keyed by job directory, recording sha256, size, and mtime_ns before/after.

nodes.label: Full Regression Pytest Session
nodes.rationale: Full suite: 121 collected across 17 test modules, 121 passed in 150.53s. Covers context repair, detection eval/targets, exports, integration, job persistence, ollama/repair, packaging/safety, product modes, scheduler/engines, slide detection, stability, study workflow, transcript formats/layers, ui v11, video extensions.
